title: FBI-UAP-D031, Digital Rendering, “Large Triangle with Red Lights,” 2023
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering created by the FBI in 2026 based on a 2023 civilian report of a UAP near Colorado Springs.

incidents.summary: Artistic rendering of a large triangular craft with red lights observed near Colorado Springs.
incidents.quote: A nighttime photograph of a dark, triangular craft hovering in a clear, star-filled sky.
